title: 고준위 방사성폐기물 관리위원회 직제 / queue:ADDENDUM:35762:20250923:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
Addenda <Presidential Decree No. 35762, September 23, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on September 26, 2025.
Article 2 (Transfer of Public Officials Following Transfer of Functions)
Pursuant to Article 2 of the Addenda to Presidential Decree No. 35761, partially amending the Organization of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and Its Affiliated Institutions, two public officials of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy at the time this Decree enters into force (one Grade V official and one Grade VI official) shall be deemed public officials belonging to the Commission and shall be transferred to the Commission from the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy.
